zh-CN:
更新内容
• 接入 Last.fm：在「设置 → 常规 → Last.fm」填入自备的应用凭据并连接账号后，播放自动上报听歌记录与正在播放；离线时本地缓存，联网或重启后自动补报
• Last.fm 本地历史补报：可将已有本地播放历史按原始时间补报最近 14 天，并可开启「允许按导入当天补报更早历史」
• Last.fm 收藏上报：本地收藏/取消收藏自动同步为 Last.fm 喜爱曲目，也可手动上报现有收藏
• 外观设置新增「程序字体」，可更换界面字体（默认 Segoe UI）；歌词与桌面歌词字体默认跟随程序字体，均可开启独立选择
• 搜索支持按原始文件名（含扩展名）匹配
• 修复启动后首次播放等待解码库冷加载，首次播放更快出声
• 修复歌词首行与末词的浮动效果丢失
en:
Release Notes
• Last.fm integration: enter your own Last.fm API credentials and connect your account in Settings → General → Last.fm; played tracks are reported automatically, including now playing. Offline plays are cached locally and submitted after reconnect or restart
• Last.fm history import: submit existing local play history with its original timestamps (last 14 days by default), with an option to assign older history to the import day
• Last.fm favorites sync: local likes and unlikes are uploaded to your Last.fm loved tracks; existing favorites can also be uploaded manually
• New app font picker in Appearance settings (Segoe UI by default); lyrics and desktop lyrics follow the app font by default, each with an independent-font toggle
• Search now also matches original file names (including extension)
• Fixed the first playback after launch waiting for decoder libraries to cold-load — playback now starts faster
• Fixed the floating animation missing for the first lyrics line and the final word
